children: This is the gallery subpage for the Tesla. It contains images of every skin, descriptions, skin information and more.

Grey tesla with yellow details.

Operated by a humanoid with dark skin, green shirt, blue pants, black shoes and yellow and blue hardhat.

Operator wields a remote button which activates the tesla to attack enemies.
'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000006-QINU`"'

Additional rings around the tesla.

Black backpack on the operator.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000007-QINU`"'

Tesla is now taller and has a few columns on the sides.

Operator now has grey headphones, shades and longer gloves. Blue and yellow details are now orange and black.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000008-QINU`"'

Now has a different orange and grey tesla with a few containers on the side.

Operator now has a bigger backpack, a bag, brown holsters and a yellow light on hardhat.

Remote button now has antenna.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000009-QINU`"'

Tesla is now even bigger.

Operator now has grey goggles with neon white lens. Black and orange details are now black and yellow.

Now wields a upgraded remote button.
skin was obtained from Level 40 of the

Large green potted plant with sharp teeth and purple leaves.

Gardened by a humanoid with pale skin, blue shirt, green overalls, yellow shoes and a yellow wide-brimmed hat.

Gardener wields a yellow watering can which activates the plant to attack enemies.
'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000000A-QINU`"'

Additional details and larger leaves on the plant, vase now has a barricade tape around it.

Yellow apron and black vest on the gardener.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000000B-QINU`"'

Plant is now taller and has additional details. Green spikes extend from the vase.

Gardener now has a dark green left arm, a yellow glove and a gas mask connected to a yellow tank on its back.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000000C-QINU`"'

Plant is now larger and with additional details.

Wide-brimmed hat on gardener replaced with a blue hood and a visor with dark lens.

Watering can is now attached to the gardener's tank via a tube.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000000D-QINU`"'

Plant is now massive and more detailed, vase spikes now have glowing pink tips.

Gardener now has black bands around sleeves.

Now has a second gardener carrying a clipboard.

Grey stone totem surrounded by purple vines and placed on a grey pedestal.

Operator by a humanoid with pink skin, black robe, purple belt, purple pants, grey shoes and a purple mask.
'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000000E-QINU`"'

Totem now has a hole in it exposing pink parts.

Pink bandages on arms and a grey and purple vest on the operator.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000000F-QINU`"'

Body is now tied to the totem.

Grey tombstone next to the totem.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000011-QINU`"'

Totem now stands on a broken pedestal while being covered by larger vines and corruption.

Now has a different body with a darker skin, multiple cracks on its body and various spikes.

Purple crystals and shoulder-pads on operator.
